card.title: I’ve Done This Before
card.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll have this tent up before the rain. I'm familiar with these sleeves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This one has clips. The poles cross first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, the clip system. Cross the poles; then we attach the fabric.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That fabric's the outer cover. We're standing on the inner tent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Step off the inner tent and we'll raise it first. I always lay everything out.

mechanism: A learns a tent's assembly from corrections while treating every revised step as the familiar intended sequence.
confusable: Unlike simply denying an error, A must actually use the new information to proceed with the task.
comparison: D42-b changes materials and sequence after each clue; D42-a changes coffee controls while claiming tailored service.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
